newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel, Jordan officials meet on border attack.
newsitem.headline: Israel, Jordan officials meet on border attack.

text.p: Israeli and Jordanian military officials met in Tel Aviv on Monday to discuss the lessons of an attack earlier this month by a Jordanian soldier who killed seven Israeli schoolgirls, an Israeli army spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said the officials agreed on new regulations to ensure better cooperation in case of future border incidents.
"The Israelis gave the Jordanians some of the points that emerged from an Israeli investigation of the incident that require Jordanian notice," the spokeswoman said.
"The sides agreed on a change of the regulations so there will be full cooperation during events. They also agreed on a meeting of commanders to practice the new regulations."
Jordan's King Hussein travelled to Israel last week to visit the seven families of the victims and offer his personal condolences.
